$comment: Light-appearance color roles, single source for iOS / Android / Web. Before this file light colors were hand-written per end and drifted (bluish inset, gray levels, translucent containers, same token name with opposite meaning). Authority for values: 文档/产品/设计/设计Token与暗色模式.md §二 (neutral and status) and dark-palettes.v1.json light.palettes.dark (brand roles of the default palette; `brandKey` names the field and the two files must agree). Every end has one contract test that resolves each listed token in the light appearance with the default palette and asserts color equals `color` (#RRGGBB) and alpha equals `alpha` (default 1) within `alphaTolerance` (8-bit alpha quantization). iOS names are `Palette.x` (OriveoTheme.Palette) or `V2.Colors.x`; Android names are OriveoColors fields of LightOriveoColors; Web names are custom properties in the `:root, [data-theme='light']` block of packages/ui/src/tokens/variables.css. An empty list means the end has no token for that role (`note` says what it uses instead). Non-default palettes change only the brand roles, by light.palettes.<id>. scripts/color-role-coverage.mjs takes its role vocabulary from here: a color token referenced by a page must appear in some role, in `webComponentTokens`, or in `pending`. `pending` lists tokens that are known to differ from their role and the unit that fixes them; each end's contract test asserts `current` for them (`current` is opaque, alpha 1) so the entry must be removed when the unit lands.

fill.name: Icon-only brand fill (carries no text)
fill.note: iOS uses Color.brand(light: \.fill) in place, Android OriveoLightBrand.fill in place.

fillText.name: Brand fill that carries text (primary button, selected block, switch on)

fillPressed.name: Pressed brand fill
fillPressed.note: Web has hover instead of pressed; --o-primary-hover is a hover state, not this role.

onPrimary.name: Text on brand fill or gradient

textSafe.name: Brand text on light surfaces (links, keyword text)

ink.name: Brand icons and strokes on light surfaces
ink.note: Web --o-primary-fill-text equals ink only in the default palette (设计Token §4.4).

primarySubtle.name: Translucent brand tint (8%) for overlays such as focus and hover; chips use soft

primaryGlow.name: Brand glow behind focused or selected items
primaryGlow.note: Web --o-glow-primary is a 3px focus-ring box-shadow, a different role.

focusRing.name: Focus ring stroke around a focused input
focusRing.note: Android-only extension property (val OriveoColors.x: Color in OriveoColors.kt); iOS and Web have no token for this role.

composerBorder.name: Composer input border
composerBorder.note: Android-only extension property (val OriveoColors.x: Color in OriveoColors.kt); iOS and Web have no token for this role.

accentSubtle.name: Translucent accent tint
accentSubtle.note: Android-only extension property (val OriveoColors.x: Color in OriveoColors.kt); iOS and Web have no token for this role.

bgSubtle.name: Secondary area background (grouped lists, migration page)

bgInset.name: Neutral inset (tool cards, search chips, Skills banners); never bluish

mutedFill.name: Web hover / selected background and secondary fill (skeletons, secondary buttons, badges, icon plates) on white surfaces
mutedFill.note: Web only. Before F·U17b Web took this gray from --o-surface-raised; touch ends have no hover state.

surfaceOverlay.name: Translucent page-background overlay
surfaceOverlay.note: Android-only extension property (val OriveoColors.x: Color in OriveoColors.kt); iOS and Web have no token for this role.

surfaceChrome.name: Top bar and tab bar background

neutralFill.name: Neutral fill for secondary capsule buttons (#767680 12%, follows no palette)

shadow.name: Shadow color
shadow.note: Web shadows are composite values, listed in webComponentTokens.

webComponentTokens.$comment: Web-only component tokens referenced by pages: composite values (gradients, shadows) or aliases with no single-color role. Their values live in variables.css; listing them here makes the page reference accounted for.
